sources.title: Owner-supplied Plaza Quezon overhead reference
sources.note: Inspected 2026-10-02; image date unknown. Southern corner foliage and northern edge trees guide bounded planting, small grass islands and connected side approaches. Complete mapped grounds, standing stage roof, roads and existing crossing govern fits where photo orientation differs. Positions, counts, dimensions and heights are visual estimates; species, roof openings, fountain identity and redevelopment completion are not inferred. Reference bitmap remains ignored evidence.
